title: Woman Reading in Bed
description: A woman with dark curly hair lies on her side in a luxurious bed, propped on a golden pillow and smiling as she reads an open comic book. The bed is covered in a colorful patchwork quilt with cartoon panels, surrounded by scattered comic pages, a lit star-shaped lamp, and a teacup on the nightstand.
prompt: A beautiful woman with dark curly hair lies smiling on her side in a lavish bed, propped up on a golden pillow while reading an open comic book under a glowing star-shaped bedside lamp. She is partially covered by a vibrant patchwork quilt featuring colorful cartoon panels and hearts. Scattered comic pages lie on the bed, a teacup sits on the nightstand in a dimly lit cozy bedroom with purple tones.
